text: でっかい　コイキング　みせて　くれるのも　わすれんでな！

structure.jp: でっかい　コイキング　みせて　くれるのも
structure.en: showing me a huge Magikarp, too

patterns.name: 〜ないでください
patterns.explanation: ないで at the end of a sentence is a short way to say 'please don't'. わすれんで is the old-man form of わすれないで. わすれんでな = 'don't forget, okay'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: くれる after a て-verb means someone does it for me. みせて　くれる = 'show it to me (as a kindness)'.

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like '-ing'. みせて　くれるの = 'showing it to me'.
